content:
Nina S: Found a Vault wrapped token blob in a partner S3 log archive (partner confirmed internal-only). blob looks like `vault:v1:...` url-encoded in query params. need rotation.
Rafael M: Do we know what path unwraps to? can you paste the sanitized unwrap output?
Nina S: It unwraps to `svc-sync-staging@infra`, path `secret/data/staging/sync-config`. wrapper TTL was long.
Aisha T: Priority: revoke token, rotate secret at that path, and rewrap any KMS-encrypted backups. Rafael can you query Vault audit for unwrap events?
Rafael M: On it: `vault audit tail -path=secret/data/staging/sync-config | grep unwrap` returning 2 unwraps this month, last at 2026-03-20T23:01Z by approle `svc-sync-staging`.
Tom B: I'll coordinate with infra to schedule a 20m freeze and restart sync workers after rotation. which clusters?
Nina S: cluster-staging-1 and -2. runtime role `approle-staging-sync` used.
Aisha T: RBAC follow-up: remove `wrap_create` from non-admin roles and audit who can create wrapped tokens. Opened ticket SEC-ROT-2026-084.
security-bot: reminder: assemble evidence (audit tail, revoked token uid, partner ack). recommended severity: P2.
deploy-bot: scan recorded: partner-logs bucket pattern matched. checklist created.
Rafael M: Revoke command executed: `vault token-revoke -id s.xxxxx` 3:02Z -> Success.
Tom B: Rotated secret, updated k8s env and restarted deployments, health checks passed.
Nina S: Partner confirmed no external access. closing coordination. Postmortem items: log-scrub middleware, tighter wrap policies, KMS rewrap cadence.
Aisha T: I'll own postmortem writeup and add remediation deadlines. thanks team. :thumbsup:
